definitions.explanation: Ordinal counter attaching to a number plus {年|ねん} to mark the Nth year since something started, such as a job, a marriage, or any ongoing situation.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}で{三年目|さんねんめ}だ。
examples.english: This year is my third year.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}{五年目|ごねんめ}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
examples.english: I was promoted in my fifth year at the company.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{十年目|じゅうねんめ}の{記念|きねん}に、{家族|かぞく}で{旅行|りょこう}に{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: To mark our tenth year of marriage, our family went on a trip together.

notes:
Combines a counter ({年|ねん} years) with the ordinal suffix {目|め} (Nth). The counted year is inclusive: {一年目|いちねんめ} is the first year, not the year after the first.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{三年目|さんねんめ}: third year at the company
- {結婚|けっこん}{十年目|じゅうねんめ}: tenth year of marriage
- {留学|りゅうがく}{二年目|にねんめ}: second year of study abroad
- {創業|そうぎょう}{百年目|ひゃくねんめ}: hundredth year since founding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年間|ねんかん}: a span of N years (duration) — {三年間|さんねんかん} "for three years"
- {年|ねん}{後|ご}: N years later — {三年後|さんねんご} "three years from now"
